verdict.rationale: Otter's Public API is versioned only by its /v1 base path. The help-center evidence explicitly says there is no version lifecycle beyond that path, so nothing describes deprecation timelines, sunset notices, or change management. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/changelog, multiple or negotiated API versions, machine-readable spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: base URL https://api.otter.ai/v1 with API-key auth
